# Coderovo — Your Technology Team, Beyond Borders

> Coderovo helps businesses build, scale, and maintain digital solutions through flexible software engineering teams and reliable IT expertise.

## Core Capabilities
- **Custom Software Development**: Full-stack web applications, mobile platforms, microservices, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise software engineering.
- **Business Systems & IT Support**: Operational workflow automation, ERP/CRM integration, system monitoring, database administration, and ongoing maintenance.
- **Monthly Outsourcing**: Dedicated offshore engineers and developers integrated seamlessly into your engineering cadence.
- **Project-Based Delivery**: Milestone-driven development with fixed scope, clear accountability, and predictable timelines.

## Priority Pages
- [Home](https://coderovo.com/): Overview of Coderovo services, engagement models, technology stack, security standards, and client partnerships.
- [Custom Software Development](https://coderovo.com/services/software-development): High-performance web and mobile application engineering, cloud microservices, and system architecture.
- [Business Systems & Support](https://coderovo.com/services/business-systems-support): Enterprise business software support, system integration, SLA management, and infrastructure stability.
- [Monthly Outsourcing](https://coderovo.com/services/monthly-outsourcing): Dedicated engineering talent and remote technical team scaling.
- [Project-Based Services](https://coderovo.com/services/project-based-services): Fixed-scope software engineering with structured milestones and delivery excellence.

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Java, Spring Boot, Python
- Databases: MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL
- DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Keycloak, JWT authentication
